description: Status of one print job you own (queued, sent to the agent, delivered or failed) plus when the agent last connected. 'delivered' means the agent handed the bytes to the printer; it does not prove the label came out. `printer_status` is the printer's own status reading taken after delivery (health ready / blocked / unknown, flags such as paused, head_open, media_out, ribbon_out); null means the printer was not asked, and no reading ever confirms that the label printed.
name: print_status
title: Print job status
